_comment: Hint popups (placeholders; the original hint texts were server data). Keys are triggers: welcome, death, level, kill, loot.

welcome.title: Welcome to Telon
welcome.text: Move with W A S D and hold the right mouse button to look around. Press Enter to chat. Right-click a creature to target it, then use the abilities on your hotbar.

kill.title: Your First Victory
kill.text: Defeated creatures leave a corpse. Target it and press U (or right-click it) to loot coin and items.

loot.title: Looting
loot.text: Click an item in the loot window to take it, or Loot All to take everything. Items go into your bags (B).

level.title: Level Up
level.text: You have gained a level! Your attributes and health grow with each level. Visit a trainer to learn new abilities.

death.title: Death
death.text: You have died. Release to return to your bind point; your tombstone stays where you fell. Each death adds experience debt, which half of your next experience pays off.
